title: Seitan Teriyaki Wrap
description: A fusion Japanese dish featuring seitan, teriyaki sauce, and a wrap. A great alternative to traditional teriyaki chicken or beef.
instructions: 1. Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
2. Add nutty to the pan and stir for 1 minute.
3. Add seitan to the pan and cook until browned, about 3-4 minutes.
4. Pour in Syrian and stir to coat seitan evenly.
5. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
6. Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
7. Assemble the wrap by placing the seitan mixture in the center.
